title: Migrate Cyclotron docs site (publish) onto the standard front end

comments.author: home
comments.text: Code migrated (Cyclotron PR #74 merged: papyrus-newsroom 5.1.0, anthus-markus 0.13, site-url, docs/index.md added). NOT published: GitHub Pages not enabled for AnthusAI/Cyclotron and DOCS_SITE_ENABLED unset. To publish: Pages source GitHub Actions, DOCS_SITE_ENABLED=true (and DOCS_DEPLOY if gated). Core bug seen: docs_site without docs/index.md lists the generated Index and Not Found pages on the home page; the not-found page is then deleted (broken link).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Verified live 2026-10-21: https://anthusai.github.io/Cyclotron/ serves 200 text/html, /llms.txt 200 text/plain, /index.md 200 text/markdown, /sitemap.xml 200 application/xml. Pages is enabled (workflow) with DOCS_SITE_ENABLED and DOCS_DEPLOY set. The generated Index/Not Found home-page listing bug noted earlier is not tracked here any more; docs/index.md exists.
